# dispatch 0.2.0 notice provenance

The published Cargo package declares `license = "MIT"` and lists Steven Sheldon as author. Neither that package nor the reviewed upstream repository supplies a separate license/copyright text file.

This directory therefore includes the standard SPDX MIT license template, with its placeholders unchanged, plus this disclosure. It does not invent a copyright year, owner assignment, or an upstream-authored notice. Package author and license metadata are also retained in the generated dependency inventory.

Upstream: https://github.com/SSheldon/rust-dispatch/tree/f540a2d8ccaebf0e87f5805033b9e287e8d01ba5

Template: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/license-list-data/v3.26.0/text/MIT.txt

This is a transparent fallback for an upstream notice omission, not a legal opinion.
